default:
  image: node:24-alpine
  cache:
    key:
      files:
        - package-lock.json
    paths:
      - node_modules/
      - .npm/

stages:
  - install
  - build
  - e2e
  - deploy

install:
  stage: install
  script:
    - npm install --cache .npm --prefer-offline
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - node_modules/
    expire_in: 1 hour

build:
  stage: build
  needs: ['install']
  script:
    - npm run build
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - dist/
    expire_in: 1 week

e2e:
  stage: e2e
  image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble
  script:
    - npm install
    - cd example
    - npm install
    - cd ..
    - npm run test

publish:
  stage: deploy
  only:
    - main
  when: manual
  dependencies:
    - install
  before_script:
    - echo "Setting up npm authentication..."
    - echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_ACCESS_TOKEN}" > ~/.npmrc
    - echo "registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/" >> ~/.npmrc
    - echo "always-auth=true" >> ~/.npmrc
    - cat ~/.npmrc
    - echo "Verifying npm authentication..."
    - npm whoami
    - echo "Authentication successful."
  script:
    - echo "Prepare npm deployment..."
    - npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline
    - npm run build:package
    - cd dist/package
    - echo "Package contents:"
    - ls -la
    - echo "Package.json version:"
    - cat package.json | grep version
    - echo "Publishing package to npmjs.org..."
    - npm stage publish
    - echo "Package published to npmjs.org successfully."
    - echo "Please verify the package manually."
